insight: Profitable within months of its 2024 launch with just seven employees, then raised a $16M Eurazeo-led seed at $10M ARR.
name: Arcads
tagline: AI video ads with realistic UGC-style actors in minutes.
description: A video ad generator for performance marketers: pick from 1,000+ licensed AI actors or create a custom avatar, feed it a script, and get social-ready UGC-style ads with emotion control, captions, and B-roll. Localizes campaigns into 30+ languages and supports product demo, unboxing, and fashion try-on formats. Its workflow canvas lets ad teams batch and iterate variants together.
edge: Purpose-built for performance marketers: 1,000+ AI actors with emotion control churn out UGC-style ad variants, not general-purpose video.
pros: Custom avatars from your own footage

references.title: Arcads.ai Raises 16 Million USD in Seed Funding
